title: Northern Vietnam — Christmas to New Year
notes: 9 days / 8 nights, 24 Dec 2026 - 1 Jan 2027, two travellers from Singapore. Bases: Hanoi (Christmas) -> Ha Giang loop as an easy-rider pillion (the centrepiece) -> Ninh Binh/Tam Coc (best weather and the best photographs of the three) -> Hanoi for NYE. Sapa/Fansipan, Ha Long/Cat Ba and Cao Bang were all considered and excluded - reasons in /research/regions.md and /research/weather.md. BUDGET READING: the S$1,500/person cap is EXCLUDING international flights, per the brief; the SIN-HAN return is estimated separately at S$450-700/person (unverified for these dates) and sits outside the cap. Planned on-the-ground spend is S$978/person - S$522 under the cap, which is deliberate headroom for peak-season hotel rates. All money in this app is SGD; VND prices are stated in the item notes and converted at 1 SGD = 20,285 VND (open.er-api.com, rate dated 6 Oct 2026). DATE FLEXIBILITY: only the Christmas (24-25 Dec) and NYE (31 Dec) hotel nights are genuinely scarce; everything else can move +/-2 days. The plan assumes the loop departs Hanoi on the 21:00 sleeper bus on 25 Dec and that 25 Dec is spent in Hanoi, so Hanoi round 1 is ONE night, not two - the 25th is spent on the bus. day_cost on each itinerary day = that day's itemised costs for one person plus that night's share of the room.
